item.title: Priormarket – a fundamentals research terminal for Kalshi/Polymarket
item.summary: Started using Kalshi and Polymarket casually. Wanted to see if there was any grading algorithms for trades out there, but only really found arbitrage scanners. Decided to build Priormarket, a dashboard to track trades with a built in fair-value model that grades contracts against real signals; price, polling, historical base rates, news, smart-money flow. Not fully finished yet, just started this project. Want to know if this solves a real problem for people who seriously trade on prediction markets. I'm an econometrics student just trying an impulse. Looking for feedback as well. https://priormarket.vercel.app/ Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49203035 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
